# ECN-2026-021 - Change notice - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Reason for change
- A review of operational records and vendor guidance has identified that the current machine control settings do not explicitly limit the system pressure to the manufacturer-recommended maximum. To mitigate risk of seal failure and pump overload during machining cycles, the hydraulic system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) will be defined and enforced in the machine control and documented in maintenance procedures.
- This change aligns the press configuration with preventative maintenance practices referenced in SB-1029 and the process control expectations in SOP-P1-L3-01.

Affected items
- Hydraulic pressure setpoint in the machine PLC and HMI for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Alarm and interlock logic associated with overpressure condition on EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Operator and maintenance procedures that reference allowable system pressures for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 (update to SOP-P1-L3-01 required).
- Spare parts and inspection criteria in SB-1029 where pressure-related wear items are listed for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.

Implementation
- Configure PLC/HMI for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 to enforce a hard limit of 295 bar as the system pressure limit. Integrate an immediate machine inhibit and visible alarm if pressure exceeds this limit.
- Update SOP-P1-L3-01 to reflect the enforced system pressure limit for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and add verification steps for operators during shift startup.
- Update SB-1029 to include inspection guidance tied to the enforced pressure limit for wear items on EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Execute a verification run on EQ-P1-L3-HP02 after configuration changes; document results in the equipment history file.

Approvals
- Engineering: ______________________
- Maintenance: ______________________
- Operations: ______________________

Related documents
- ECN-2026-035
- SB-1029
- SOP-P1-L3-01
